Commentary.Commentary: It was yet another listless performance with the ball by Zimbabwe. They failed to exert any kind of pressure throughout the innings and leaked runs courtesy of some very average bowling. 79 runs were conceded in the Powerplay and from thereon, the hosts just rode on the momentum. Namibia have posted a massive score on the board and now the visitors will have to bat out of their skin to overhaul it. Can they do it? We will find out on the other side.

A powerful batting display by Namibia! They were invited to bat first by the touring team and pounced on that opportunity. Michael Van Lingen was in full throttle right from the beginning, and the hero of the last game, Nikolaas Davin, offered him handy support. Namibia raced to 100 inside the first ten overs before losing Van Lingen. Thereafter, David played the anchor role to perfection and around him, the likes of Gerhard Erasmus and JJ Smit flourished.

Commentary.Commentary: We're not far from getting underway. Meanwhile, in Delhi, Australia are going great guns on the back of a splendid century from David Warner. The Netherlands are under pressure and it's going to be an interesting finish. You can keep an eye on the updates of that match but don't ignore this clash. First ball coming up in a few minutes...
